(2) First, pairs measured the walkways and recorded the locations of benches, doors, and garden beds. (3) Another group designed simple symbols for each feature. (4) I like maps with bright colors. (5) When we combined our work, however, several measurements did not match. (6) We returned to the courtyard, checked the disputed distances, and corrected two recording errors. (7) Finally, we added a key and tested the map by asking another class to follow it. (8) Their successful trip from the library door to the garden confirmed that our revised map was clear.

questions.prompt: Which transition best replaces however in sentence 5?

choices.A: Instead
choices.B: For example
choices.C: Nevertheless
choices.D: When

questions.correctAnswer: When
questions.explanation: When correctly introduces the time at which the mismatched measurements became apparent.
